summary: All platforms under 100 followers. Instagram reels lose 77% viewers in first 3 seconds — hooks fail to stop scroll. Curiosity hook got 0 engagement. Bluesky last 5 posts zero engagement. Instagram bio violates rules: niche/region targeting, timeframe claim, free offer outside website posts.
guidance:
- Rotate hook styles: question (2.84x) and top3 (2.29x) led on tiny n=1; avoid curiosity (0.04x).
- Drop animated_ads posts for now (0.04x service multiplier).
- Every post must read like a developer showing real work, never an ad.
- No demos, samples, guarantees, or niche/region language.
- Only offers: pay after approval + short DM conversation.

instructions.research: List 5 common SEO blog writing pain points for Indian small businesses (e.g., no time to write, don't know keywords, inconsistent posting, low traffic, can't measure ROI).
instructions.analysis: Compare question vs top3 hook performance on the two chatbot/lead-gen posts that got engagement; note structure difference.
instructions.writer: Write today's SEO blog writing post using a question hook. Open with a relatable pain point for any small business. Include pay-after-approval and DM-for-advice offers only. No niche examples — mention 2-3 varied types in one line max.
instructions.image: Create a clean static graphic: simple 3-step visual (Research → Write → Publish) with minimal text. No logos, no client names, no 'demo' labels.
instructions.video: Skip video today. If you post a reel later, script first 3 seconds as a direct question to camera/text overlay — no branding intro.

manual_tips: Update Instagram bio: remove 'hotels, cafes, gyms & homestays in Himachal', 'Rs 1499', '24 hrs', 'Free 2-min site check'. Replace with: 'Websites, AI chatbots, animated ads, lead gen & SEO blogs for small businesses across India. Pay after approval. DM to chat.'
Comment thoughtfully on 5 posts by Indian small business owners (any niche) discussing content, SEO, or online growth — no pitching.
Reply to every story mention or comment on your own posts within 2 hours.
